title: Mutual NDA — Term and Survival (standard position)
text: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue for a period of two (2) years, unless earlier terminated by either party upon thirty (30) days written notice. The confidentiality obligations set out in this Agreement shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement and shall remain in effect with respect to any Confidential Information disclosed during the term for a period of two (2) years following such expiration or termination. Confidential Information that constitutes a trade secret shall remain protected for so long as it qualifies as a trade secret under applicable law.
